name: Star Wars: Hunters - Season 5: Scum & Villainy
summary: Master thief Glikkin enters the Arena and he’s here to steal the spotlight! This new Damage Class Hunter uses his stealthy abilities to sneak around battlefields before unleashing fury with a pair of devastating vibroblades. A new battlefield, Coruscant Underworld, is also coming to the Arena in Season 5. All Hunters can now equip Mods, which modify their stats!
